identity.name: Novice Trainer
identity.description: As proof that you completed the Trainer Lord's exercises, you were gifted this.|This panel is very versatile, granting many useful parameters for anyone.

identity.name: Veteran Trainer
identity.description: As proof that you completed the Trainer Lord's exercises, you were gifted this.|This panel is very offensive, granting many parameters geared towards dispatching foes quickly.

identity.name: Ghosty Presence
identity.description: Even the ever-iconic ghosty has things you can learn.|Just lean in and listen real good, they whisper dark things and touch your butt.

identity.name: Tortuous Threestep
identity.description: No one suspected that this ultra-evil entity known as \enemy[103] would drop a node.|Good thing you were ready for it.

identity.name: ==REBORN==
identity.description: The best panel ever, hands down. You only need to acquire it somehow!

identity.name: Otherworldly Dark
identity.description: Sometimes, the dead end up reaching back and touching you in ways you don't like-|Like murderously.

identity.name: Vero Noctu
identity.description: They say that for all light there is darkness, but this darkness is counterbalanced by the night.

identity.name: Flame's Caress
identity.description: When the flames caress you, the power swells within.|It might be something else swelling, though.

identity.name: Yokai Blaze
identity.description: Killing the already-dead is an impressive feat.|Not like you cared or could even tell since it was taking fiery swings at ya like a douchebag.

identity.name: Boney Situation
identity.description: The skeleton is an age-old RPG enemy- often frail and wimpy.|These skeletors live up to that expectation in spades.

identity.name: Don Armor
identity.description: When spooky enemies don armor, they become a little different.

identity.name: Princely Flourish
identity.description: Regally speaking, one should verily be theoretically flourishing preposterously nonstop.|Indubitibly🧐.

identity.name: Gasp King
identity.description: Deadly snakes that do deadly things should be made ded faster than they ded you.

identity.name: Dragonic Sacrifice
identity.description: The dargins of Erocia can vary wildly in shape, size, color, and elemental affinity.|The Lesser Dargins are known for their petite stature, but they are still formidible.

identity.name: Lamian Revelry
identity.description:
Watching them pulse and writhe as they wound up that massive laser|
was a tempting and alluring thing to behold.

identity.name: Impish Insight
identity.description: The insight of the kappa is literally dripping with moisture.|Incase you're not sure what that means, neither am I.

identity.name: River Runs Deep
identity.description: In some regions, kappa have come together in a sort of community and begun showing more civilized behavior.|This particular kappa appears to communicate with some sort of higher deity... I wonder if we'll meet them later?

identity.name: Bounding Joy
identity.description: Cave frogs do hippity hop and lickity spit as annoyingly as you would expect.

identity.name: Crabtastical Crunchiness
identity.description: The crabs of Volcanis are no joke, what with them constantly trying to keep you rooted in-place.|It is unclear how they exist in such a hot area without just being cooked by the ambient temperature.

identity.name: Slimestep
identity.description: A slime in the depths of some no-name cave in Erocia wielded great four-step moves.|Learn from the master and step on your enemies how they like it.

identity.name: The Jigglejest
identity.description: TODO

identity.name: Temporal Tapdance
identity.description: While some slimes just absorb your essence through material breakdown,|others are more inclined to melt your face off from another dimension.

identity.name: Mostly-Seeing Eyes
identity.description: It was a stretch to call this a slime, but then you see its tentacles.|Known for gorging on bearcats during the winter, apparently.

identity.name: Flowing Fluids
identity.description: May the fluids flow and... not ebb, that would be weird. Especially from a Jelli.|Don't do that.

identity.name: Soak 'n' Spray
identity.description: Apparently, this planet has somehow managed to evolve water bats.|We aren't talking about bats that like water, we're talking bats MADE OF WATER.

identity.name: Tentacular Touch
identity.description: Sometimes you just need to reach out and slap a lot of people at once.

identity.name: Pissed Off Sprout
identity.description: The rage of a sprout (such as a Fungrowth) should never be underestimated.|Never forget.

identity.name: Scorn of Fae
identity.description: Fae's have always been the kings of being able to piss you off by throwing rocks at you.|But soon, you too will be able to piss people off by throwing rocks at them!

identity.name: Unseelie Court
identity.description: When the unseelie chaos can be encapsulated, it can eventually be converted into a battery to fuel your stats ala this node!

identity.name: Bearfisting It
identity.description: Why put a glove on it when you can just bearfist it instead?|Bearfisting is an ancient technique passed down from grizzly to grizzly.

identity.name: Descend into Darkness
identity.description: A void-consumed bear proved difficult to defeat considering its vast amount of life, but at least|you managed to pry this node from its dead bear mitts.

identity.name: Skies of the Cave
identity.description: Bats are vicious and obnoxious creatures|They are renowned far and wide for slaying young would-be protagonists.

identity.name: Call from the Dark
identity.description: TODO

identity.name: Crazy Beak
identity.description: TODO

identity.name: Resourceful Ratactics
identity.description: Rats manage to thrive in nearly all environments, including flooded rivers.|Channel your inner rat and get resourceful.

identity.name: Sting like a Bee
identity.description: The lessons learned by all of the slain needlers in the land.|Slaying these pests not only make you feel better, but also help "the people".

identity.name: Drillsation
identity.description:
Much much more than your average bumblebee, this ruthless stinger has evolved in the harshest of wildernesses to execute even mighty megataurs in a single blow.
Crits truly are deadly and piss everyone off.

identity.name: Burrow Burr
identity.description: An ancient panel with a burr still in it.|Who knows what we'll be able to do with it.

identity.name: Wriggle Dansu
identity.description:
In the far off mountains there is a legend that worms dance. No one knows why, but it is wildly entertaining to watch.
Watch it once and you'll be addicted to doing it yourself for all eternity.

identity.name: Bullheaded
identity.description: Being bullheaded isn't always a bad thing.|He grew to be big and strong from a little cow before you slayed him!

identity.name: Orcan Obediance
identity.description: The most scrubby and pathetic orc.|It mines and mines and mines. Fortunately it has tireless stamina.

identity.name: Orcan Stormcalling
identity.description: Upper eschelons of orcs are oft heavily intuned with nature, allowing manipulation of the elements.|Thunder is deadly to manipulate, so why not learn it yourself?

identity.name: Orcan Mountaineering
identity.description:
Orcs that are capable of countering are mean douchebags deserving of getting kicked in the face-
hopefully that was precisely what you did to acquire this node.

identity.name: Thief's Code
identity.description: The thief's code describes all sorts of various rules.|They are really more like guidelines, though.

identity.name: Dark Alley Deals
identity.description: TODO

identity.name: Titan's Girth
identity.description: Titans are a mighty race, surpassed only by folks who have guns, because guns obviously.|You really can just end a lot of life if you get good at shooting shit.

identity.name: Rampaging Ignition
identity.description: Its not blond babes shooting guns everywhere, but it does teach you how to respond with fire for anything.

identity.name: Electric Boogyman
identity.description: Shocking revelations are found everywhere, including places that enable you to shock back.

identity.name: Boundless Runes
identity.description:
Are robotic miners alive?
Should they get rights, too?

identity.name: Glutton's Dogma
identity.description: The dogma of the Glutton is held above all else: "thou must satiate thine hunger".

identity.name: Wrath's Dogma
identity.description: The dogma of Wrath is held above all else: "thou must satiate thine revenge".

prose.beginning: Every trick you pull lingers.|{v.skillHistoryBonus} damage for each unique skill in the last {s.window}.
prose.middle: The dead remember longer than the living:|{v.skillHistoryBonus} per unique skill, now recalled across {s.window}.
prose.end: Nothing you do is forgotten.|{v.skillHistoryBonus} per unique skill over {s.window}, and your strikes leave \state[14] behind.

prose.beginning: Death did not finish the job.|Every {s.interval}, a ward gathers worth {d.shield}.
prose.middle: The pale wall thickens:|a ward worth {d.shield} every {s.interval}, pooling up to {d.shieldCap}.
prose.end: Wraithwall eternal.|Every {s.interval}, {d.shield} of ward, three layers deep, and it holds where flesh would fold.

prose.beginning: You burn at the edges.|Every {s.interval}, anything close enough takes {s.payload} fire, and hurting you only stokes it.
prose.middle: The mantle spreads to {s.radius} and bites for {s.payload},|still answering every wound with flame.
prose.end: A scorched halo.|{s.payload} to everything within {s.radius}, pulsing faster the more of them there are, and every hit you take answers instantly.

prose.beginning: Bones do not flinch.|Every {s.perStack} of Life you are missing feeds {D.atk} and {D.mat}.
prose.middle: Graveborn fury sharpens as you fail:|{D.atk} and {D.mat} for every {s.perStack} of Life gone.
prose.end: Deathless.|{D.atk} and {D.mat} per {s.perStack} of missing Life, and everything that hits you does half of what it meant to.

prose.beginning: The hollow armor plates over what it cannot heal:|{P.def}, {P.mhp}.
prose.middle: A brittle bastion still turns a blade.|{P.def} and {P.grd}, paid for with {P.mhp}.
prose.end: A paper fortress: {P.def} against {P.mhp}.|{P.grd}, {P.ctr}, and crits land {v.critReduction} softer.

prose.beginning: Your crits carry poison: {s.chance} to sink venom worth {d.hpFormula} a tick,|and every fang after that keeps it alive longer.
prose.middle: Nothing survives the second bite.|Venom pools {s.stacks} deep, each layer draining {d.hpFormula}.
prose.end: A deluge.|Venom takes {d.hpFormula} every tick and only ever gets worse the longer you keep landing crits.

prose.beginning: A dragon's heart only wakes when the end is close.|While {s.gate}, {P.pdr}.
prose.middle: Dragonheart stirring, and stirring sooner:|while {s.gate}, {P.pdr} to every blow and {p.elementRate} off every element.
prose.end: Dragonheart aflame.|While {s.gate}: {P.pdr}, shrug {p.elementRate} off the elements, and nothing lesser can touch you at all.

prose.beginning: Hold still and the scales set like stone.|Stand {s.gate} without moving for {P.def}.
prose.middle: Stone mantle. {s.gate} of stillness and {P.def} climbs.|The longer you plant, the less anything moves you.
prose.end: A granite bastion.|{s.gate} unmoving buys {P.def} and {P.grd}; blows simply stop arriving anywhere.

prose.beginning: Patience sharpens the beam:|{v.castTimeDamageBonus} damage for every second you hold the cast.
prose.middle: Converging light.|{v.castTimeDamageBonus} per second charged, and the charge itself comes {v.castSpeedRate} quicker.
prose.end: Everything collapses to a point.|{v.castTimeDamageBonus} damage per second held, at {v.castSpeedRate} the charge rate.

prose.beginning: Something primal runs under the skin.|Energy and Void strike {v.boostElement[8]} harder.
prose.middle: Attunement spreads outward: Energy and Void at {v.boostElement[8]},|and the four base elements answer to you too at {v.boostElement[4]}.
prose.end: A primal conduit.|Every element in the world bends: nothing you throw lands at less than {v.boostElement[4]}, and Energy and Void hit for {v.boostElement[8]}.

prose.beginning: A kappa's luck rubs off.|Enemies part with {v.dropMultiplier} more than they meant to.
prose.middle: Fortune favors you twice: {v.dropMultiplier} more loot,|and {P.eva} to walk away with it.
prose.end: A trickster's gambit.|{N.dor}, {N.eva} and {N.luk} each climb by {v.evaBuffPlus}, and keep climbing every level you earn.

prose.beginning: Root yourself and the power gathers:|a stack every {s.interval} standing still, {D.mat} each, gone the moment you move.
prose.middle: A rooted tempest, {s.stacks} layers deep at {D.mat} apiece,|but one step still costs you everything.
prose.end: Rooted cataclysm.|{s.stacks} stacks at {D.mat} each, and at last you can move without losing it all: a step costs one stack, no more.

prose.beginning: The shell answers for you.|Every physical blow returns {s.payload}.
prose.middle: An iron rebuke throws {s.payload} straight back,|and nothing can parry it.
prose.end: Shellbreaker's retort returns {s.payload},|and it lands before they have finished swinging.

prose.beginning: Too slippery to pin down.|For {s.gate} after anything hits you, move {v.speedBoost} faster.
prose.middle: A swift current carries you {s.gate} clear of whatever landed,|at {v.speedBoost} speed.
prose.end: Slipstream.|{s.gate} of {v.speedBoost} movement after every hit taken, and the opening you make is sharper for it.

prose.beginning: Wounded, you vanish into ink:|{s.duration} at {D.pdr}.
prose.middle: A murky pall, {s.duration} long and {D.pdr}.|They lose you exactly when it matters.
prose.end: The abyssal veil answers any harm at all: {s.duration} at {D.pdr},|and even in clear water you keep {P.pdr}.

prose.beginning: Wounds teach the slime what hit it:|{s.duration} of {d.elementRate} against the elements.
prose.middle: Reactive gel, {s.stacks} layers thick and {s.duration} long.|The more they burn you, the less it works.
prose.end: Elemental osmosis.|{s.stacks} coats of {d.elementRate}, and now nothing elemental is unfamiliar: every element in the world, blunted.

prose.beginning: Misery is an opening.|{v.perDebuffBuff} more damage for every affliction already on them.
prose.middle: An eldritch tempest feeds itself: {v.perDebuffBuff} per affliction,|and every strike adds another.
prose.end: Eldritch maelstrom. {v.perDebuffBuff} per affliction, and each blow heaps five more on.|The wound teaches the next one where to land.

prose.beginning: Flesh knits and something else fills the gap:|{v.onSelfHpHealMp} of any healing you take returns as Magi.
prose.middle: Mana weave.|{v.onSelfHpHealMp} of your healing becomes Magi, yours and every ally's within {s.radius}.
prose.end: Arcane transfusion: any healing at all, of any kind,|pays {v.onSelfAnyHealMp} back as Magi to everyone within {s.radius}.

prose.beginning: Something restorative drifts off you.|Every {s.interval}, allies nearby mend for {s.payload}.
prose.middle: A miasma of life, {s.radius} wide,|mending {s.payload} every {s.interval}.
prose.end: Spore bloom.|{s.payload} to everyone within {s.radius} every {s.interval}, and you knit yourself back together whether anyone notices or not.

prose.beginning: You are an obstacle now.|Anything near you slows by {d.speedBoost}, and keeps slowing while it stays.
prose.middle: A living bulwark: {s.stacks} layers of mire,|each stealing {d.speedBoost} of speed and fouling their casting.
prose.end: Immovable bulk.|The mire never stops deepening: {d.speedBoost} slower with every stack, and every stack opens them {D.pdr} wider.

prose.beginning: What you inflict takes root.|Every affliction you land lingers {v.stateDurationPerc} longer.
prose.middle: A thorned curse holds twice as long:|{v.stateDurationPerc} added to everything you put on them.
prose.end: Stranglethorn.|Afflictions last {v.stateDurationPerc} longer, and anything already \state[5] takes {v.bonusDamageIfState} from you.

prose.beginning: Instinct sharpens in the waiting.|With every skill ready, {P.cri}.
prose.middle: A primal surge.|{P.cri} while nothing is spent, though the coiling costs you {P.atk} to hold.
prose.end: Primal apex.|Nothing spent, everything ready: {P.cri}, {P.atk}, and every basic attack lands {v.bonusHitsBasic} more times.

prose.beginning: The grove answers a healthy wood.|While every ally near you is {s.gate}, {P.mat}.
prose.middle: Nature's ire: {P.mat} and {P.mdf},|for as long as nobody around you is bleeding badly.
prose.end: Nature's judgment asks less and gives more.|Allies need only be {s.gate} for {P.mat} and {P.mdf}.

prose.beginning: Bark thickens where nothing disturbs it.|{s.gate} untouched and physical blows land {P.pdr} softer.
prose.middle: Tempered ironbark, and quicker to set:|{s.gate} clear buys {P.pdr} against physical harm and {P.def}.
prose.end: Ancient ironbark.|Barely {s.gate} between blows and the wood closes over: physical damage {P.pdr}, {P.def}.

prose.beginning: A quiet bloom every {s.interval} lifts one affliction from anyone within {s.radius}.
prose.middle: Cleansing petals, {s.radius} wide,|stripping {s.count} afflictions off your allies every {s.interval}.
prose.end: A sacred bloom.|Every {s.interval}, everything within {s.radius} is simply made clean, however much they were carrying.

prose.beginning: Muscle and magic start to rhyme:|{N.mat} rises by {v.matBuffPlus}.
prose.middle: A void chord runs through every swing.|{N.mat} takes {v.matBuffPlus}, and {s.chance} of your blows leave \state[14] behind.
prose.end: Void harmonics.|{N.atk} feeds {N.mat} and back again, each carrying the other in full, and {s.chance} of what you touch is unmade.

prose.beginning: Bats do not hunt alone.|With an ally inside {s.gate}, {P.hit}.
prose.middle: A chittering frenzy carries {s.gate} now:|{P.hit} and {P.eva} for as long as someone flies with you.
prose.end: A wingbeat chorus reaches {s.gate}.|{P.hit}, {P.eva}, and {P.tcr}.

prose.beginning: Harm sends you skyward:|{s.duration} of {d.speedBoost} movement, once every {s.interval}.
prose.middle: A rising gust, now every {s.interval}:|{d.speedBoost} faster and {D.eva} harder to touch while it lasts.
prose.end: Gale force.|Every {s.interval}, {s.duration} of {d.speedBoost} movement, {D.eva}, and everything that swings at you answers to itself.

prose.beginning: Rats hoard together.|Keep an ally {s.gate} and everything you learn sticks {v.aptMultiplier} better.
prose.middle: A nest egg travels: the bond holds out to {s.gate} now,|paying {N.apr} {v.aptMultiplier} and {P.exr}.
prose.end: Compound interest.|Even {s.gate} apart the share still counts: {N.sdr}, {N.apr} and {N.exr} all at {v.aptMultiplier}.

prose.beginning: The pack looks to you.|Every {s.interval}, allies within {s.radius} take {D.def}.
prose.middle: An alpha's howl carries {s.radius},|bringing {D.def} to everyone who hears it.
prose.end: Pack sovereignty.|{D.def} to all within {s.radius}, and your own guard becomes theirs: {D.mdf}.

prose.beginning: The sting carries something.|{s.chance} of your hits leave \state[16] behind.
prose.middle: A hive puncture finds the sickness first: {s.chance} to poison,|and {v.bonusDamageIfStateType} more damage to anything already carrying it.
prose.end: Lance of the hive.|Everything you touch is poisoned, and everything poisoned takes {v.bonusDamageIfStateType} from you.

prose.beginning: The network feeds on company.|Every enemy near you is worth {P.lst}.
prose.middle: A spire synapse: {P.lst} and {P.hrg} for each one that crowds you.
prose.end: Spire dominion. Every body around you gives {P.lst}, {P.hrg}, and {v.critReduction} off the crits they land.|Being surrounded is the point.

prose.beginning: Plague wants company.|\state[16] you inflict jumps {v.spread[0]} of the time to anything within {v.spread[1]}.
prose.middle: An endemic swarm: poison leaps {v.spread[1]},|taking {v.spreadPerTick} more of them every {v.spreadTick}.
prose.end: Pandemic. {v.spreadPerTick} new hosts every {v.spreadTick} out to {v.spread[1]}.|Put it on one of them and it belongs to all of them.

prose.beginning: Barbs answer every blow:|{s.payload} back to whatever struck you within {s.radius}.
prose.middle: A chitin lash reaches {s.radius} now,|returning {s.payload} for every physical hit you take.
prose.end: Barbed retribution,|and it lands twice: {s.payload} each time, to anything within {s.radius}.

prose.beginning: What mends you mends the swarm:|{v.onSelfHpHealHp} of any healing you take reaches allies within {s.radius}.
prose.middle: A siphon weave, {s.radius} wide,|sharing out {v.onSelfHpHealHp} of your healing and {v.onSelfMpHealMp} of your Magi.
prose.end: Cradle of leech.|Every drop of Life, Magi and Tech that reaches you reaches everyone within {s.radius} too.

prose.beginning: Keep moving and it builds: {D.atk} a step, {s.stacks} deep,|and the next skill you throw spends all of it.
prose.middle: Gathering thunder, {s.stacks} steps' worth at {D.atk} apiece.|Run further, hit once, hit enormously.
prose.end: Stampede.|There is no ceiling worth naming: {D.atk} per step, and every step you have ever taken goes into the swing.

prose.beginning: A warchief does not wait.|Every cooldown you carry runs shorter: {P.cdr}.
Fight dirty.|{s.chance} of your hits leave them clawing at their eyes.
prose.middle: A dirty trick every time: {s.chance} to \state[18],|and {P.eva} while they swing at nothing.
prose.end: A blinding gambit.|Everything you hit goes blind, and every dodge you make leaves them wide open to something far worse.

prose.beginning: A thick skull has its uses.|Roots find less and less purchase on you, until they stop holding you at all.
prose.middle: Stone temper: nothing roots you,|and what would disable you slips off more often than it lands.
prose.end: An adamant mind.|Neither root nor disabling touches you, and half of what would move you simply doesn't.

prose.beginning: A field medic wastes nothing.|Everything you consume works {P.pha} harder.
prose.middle: Trail rations keep: {s.foodTypes} last longer on you,|and the keeping shows in {s.statList} across the board.
prose.end: A battlefield banquet.|Every food lingers, every stat it feeds climbs, and Metabolize no longer costs you the meal.

prose.beginning: Nothing sticks to a titan.|Every affliction you carry is worth {P.atk} and {P.mat}.
prose.middle: A relentless march: each curse on you gives {P.atk} and {P.mat},|and {P.pdr} off everything they throw.
prose.end: Juggernaut. Every affliction feeds you {P.atk} and {P.mat}, {P.pdr}, and {P.lst}.|Let them pile on.

prose.beginning: Everything you throw lands wider:|blast radius {v.radiusRate}.
prose.middle: A blast front, not a blast point:|{v.radiusRate} across and {v.thicknessRate} deep.
prose.end: Ground zero. {v.radiusRate} and {v.thicknessRate} on everything, and then more on top of that.|There is no edge left to stand on.

prose.beginning: The chassis maintains itself.|Every {s.interval}, {s.payload} back, no thought required.
prose.middle: A maintenance cycle worth {s.payload} every {s.interval}.|Attrition simply stops working on you.
prose.end: Autonomic overdrive.|{s.payload} every {s.interval}, and the better you get at fighting the more it mends.

prose.beginning: Every thread you tie pulls harder:|{v.perDebuffBuff} more damage for each affliction on them.
prose.middle: A soul bind.|{v.perDebuffBuff} per affliction, and {s.chance} of your hits take their hands away entirely.
prose.end: Soul rend.|{v.perDebuffBuff} per affliction, and every strike risks silencing them and disabling them both at once.

prose.beginning: What you break, you spend.|Shattering a shield bursts for {s.payload}, out to {s.radius}.
prose.middle: A capacitor surge throws {s.payload} back out across {s.radius}.
prose.end: Meltdown.|The entire shield detonates, amplified by your own, and everything within {s.radius} learns what it was holding back.

prose.beginning: Resistance is a suggestion.|The four great elements pierce {v.pierceElement} deeper.
prose.middle: Elemental flux: six elements now,|each cutting {v.pierceElement} through whatever they hide behind.
prose.end: An elemental singularity.|Every element there is pierces {v.pierceElement}, and nothing is safe from anything.

prose.beginning: You feel what they feel.|Whenever an ally within {s.radius} is mended, {v.onAllyHpHealHp} of it reaches you too.
prose.middle: An empathic echo carries {s.radius}:|{v.onAllyHpHealHp} of every kindness they receive lands on you as Life and Magi both.
prose.end: An empathic nexus.|Life, Magi, Tech: anything that restores an ally within {s.radius} restores {v.onAllyHpHealHp} of it in you.

prose.beginning: A small bargain, honestly struck:|{v.sdpMultiplier} more points from everything you kill.
prose.middle: The devil's wager pays {v.sdpMultiplier},|and it has never yet asked for anything back.
prose.end: The devil's due. {v.sdpMultiplier} more points, and another {v.sdpBonusFormula} for every mastery you already carry.|The debt compounds in your favor.
